data_dependencies: causal underlying price, volume, NBBO, volatility, catalyst, and structural evidence
exact point-in-time option chain, contract terms, two-sided quotes, sizes, volume, open interest, Greeks, and implied volatility when available
expiration, exercise, assignment, corporate-action, and earnings calendar state
causal_inputs.decision_time_rule: Freeze the underlying thesis, exact legs, chain, quote, terms, and payoff at the research timestamp.
causal_inputs.completed_bar_rule: Underlying completed-bar features end at T-1; option quotes must retain their own timestamps and may not be inferred from the underlying.
causal_inputs.missing_data_rule: Any unavailable chain, leg quote, size, term, assignment, or cost input remains UNKNOWN and makes an executability or profitability claim ineligible.

setup_rules: UNKNOWN until causal single-leg and defined-max-loss vertical spread families are separately versioned
the underlying must qualify independently before any option expression is evaluated
entry_or_research_rules: research observations only; every spread and sell-to-open leg has zero broker and trade authority
freeze exact strikes, expiration, side, quantity, net debit or credit, maximum loss, maximum gain, and cancellation rule at T
exit_or_outcome_rules: UNKNOWN until event-sequenced multi-leg fills, early-close, expiration, assignment, pin, and liquidity assumptions are versioned
grade the complete position after all leg costs and never use the underlying move as a substitute for option P&L
invalidations: missing or stale leg quote, crossed market, failed depth, changed terms, earnings or corporate-action conflict, or undefined maximum loss
any attempted LIVE, PAPER, broker, risk, or allocation action under this SHADOW-only contract

notes: Every spread and sell-to-open expression is research-only.
Modeled maximum loss must include contract multiplier, commissions, spread, slippage, assignment, and early-close assumptions.

lane_risk_translation.notional_rule: UNKNOWN; no contract quantity, buying power, or capital is authorized or reserved.
lane_risk_translation.stop_defined_risk_rule: UNKNOWN until exact multi-leg closeout and stop behavior are modeled from executable leg quotes.
lane_risk_translation.stress_loss_rule: Must use contractual maximum loss plus modeled legging, assignment, pin, gap, halt, and liquidity stress without assuming a stop fill.
lane_adjustments: single-leg long options, debit spreads, and defined-risk credit spreads are distinct evidence lanes
group multiple contracts and legs on one underlying thesis into one independent position episode
0DTE, exercise, assignment action, and live sell-to-open remain excluded

cost_execution_model.quote_source: UNKNOWN until contemporaneous executable quote and size exist for every leg.
cost_execution_model.spread_model: UNKNOWN; must model each leg and executable net spread rather than option OHLC range.
cost_execution_model.slippage_model: UNKNOWN; must include multi-leg fill sequence, partial fill, cancel/replace, and closeout slippage.
cost_execution_model.fee_model: UNKNOWN; must include per-contract and regulatory costs and may not silently assume zero.
cost_execution_model.fill_model: UNKNOWN; midpoint fills are prohibited unless supported by a prospectively calibrated fill-probability model.
cost_execution_model.maximum_contractual_loss_rule: Record exact contractual maximum loss for every frozen leg set, then add non-overlapping fees and execution/assignment stresses.

session_calendar_rules.calendar: U.S. options and underlying equity calendars with expiration, earnings, exercise, and corporate-action awareness
session_calendar_rules.research_or_entry_window: SHADOW research timestamps only; no executable option or spread window is active.
session_calendar_rules.mandatory_flat_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE_SHADOW_ONLY; any future live hold, expiration, or overnight rule requires a new explicit contract.
session_calendar_rules.holiday_rule: Do not synthesize option sessions or maturity across closed-market dates without explicit calendar handling.

entry_or_research_kill_conditions: exact chain, leg quote, contract term, or timestamp coverage unavailable
multi-leg execution, fees, assignment, pin, or maximum-loss model absent
future leakage or repeated-contract pseudo-replication detected
any non-SHADOW book mode or nonzero trade, risk, reservation, or allocation authority
suspension_criteria.operator_stop_semantics: Registered SHADOW research is zero-authority; it cannot alter, release, or bypass the LIVE emergency-entry stop.

known_failure_modes: stale or incomplete chains can make a spread look executable when it is not
multi-leg slippage can erase theoretical edge
assignment and pin risk can invalidate simplified payoff assumptions
effective sample size can be overstated by repeated contracts on one underlying
